query: What randomized-intervention or instrumental-variable designs are feasible to test causal dependence of AI outputs on human inputs in generative models?

response.query: What randomized-intervention or instrumental-variable designs are feasible to test causal dependence of AI outputs on human inputs in generative models?
response.answer: Randomized-intervention designs and instrumental-variable designs can test causal dependence of AI outputs on human inputs in generative models by manipulating human input variables and using external instruments to isolate causal effects.
